newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's 1997 budget heads for cyberspace.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's 1997 budget heads for cyberspace.

text.p: Malaysia's state-owned broadcasting firm said the nation's 1997 national budget would be transmitted via the Internet on Friday, the first Asian country to do so.

Radio Television Malaysia (RTM) has teamed up with Malaysian computer concern MCSB Systems (M) Bhd to beam digitalised images of Finance Minister Anwar Ibrahim announcing the budget in Parliament, the national Bernama news agency reported late on Wednesday.
RTM's chairman Ismail Mustapa called the transmission a historic event.
The live announcement of the budget in Parliament will be captured and updated on the Internet at five-second intervals, Bernama reported.
The broadcast can be found on the Internet by accessing the RTM homepage on (http://live.rtm.net.my/budget97).
Those not connected to cyberspace will be able to get printed copies of the budget at 5 p.m. local time (0900 GMT) on Friday.
